crossRefs.note: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.
The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities…
and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.
and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and…
“ ‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Kanah
people.line: A brook marking the border between Ephraim and Manasseh

people.name: Tappuah
people.line: Canaanite city allotted to Ephraim and Manasseh

translations.web: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;
translations.bsb: From Tappuah the border went westward to the Brook of Kanah and ended at the Sea. This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Ephraim,
translations.kjv: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
translations.asv: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;
